title: Bipropellant pre-burn check
body: Before any bipropellant maneuver: verify oxidiser tank pressure within 10 % nominal; verify fuel tank pressure within 10 % nominal; verify mixture ratio sensor health; arm ignition only after both verifications pass.

title: Deployable mechanism verification
body: Solar array / antenna / boom deployments verified via 2-of-3 sensor concurrence (microswitch + tilt-sensor + strain-gauge). Deployment-failed annunciator triggers contingency sequence: re-attempt motor drive, then percussive release if mechanism allows.

title: Watchdog reset rate limit
body: On-board computer watchdog resets > 3 in 1 hour shall trigger downgrade to backup OBC. Watchdog state preserved through reset for ground forensic analysis.
citation: AAUSAT-3 lessons learned; AAUS lecture series 2012

title: EDAC memory scrubbing cadence
body: Single-bit EDAC errors shall be corrected and counted; > 100 corrections per day triggers diagnostic. Memory scrubbing frequency tuned to upset rate (typical 1/min for LEO, 1/hr for GEO).

title: Comm subsystem mode switching
body: Comm modes: HIGH (HGA, full data rate), MEDIUM (omni, reduced rate), LOW (beacon-only, 4 bps housekeeping). Mode downgrade triggered by TX power degradation, attitude loss, or eclipse-margin breach. Mode upgrade requires 30-min stable nominal margin.

title: FDIR escalation hierarchy
body: Fault Detection / Isolation / Recovery: Level 1 = component-internal recovery (retry, watchdog); Level 2 = component switch to backup (within 10 s); Level 3 = subsystem mode demotion (within 60 s); Level 4 = spacecraft safe-hold (within 5 min). Escalation paths cited in ECSS-E-ST-70-32C.

title: Attitude knowledge requirement
body: Attitude knowledge shall be ≤ 0.05 deg for science pointing, ≤ 0.5 deg for nominal ops, ≤ 5 deg for safe mode. Each requirement supported by sensor health: star tracker for science, sun + magnetometer for nominal, sun-only for safe mode.

title: Propellant budget reserve
body: End-of-life propellant reserve shall be ≥ 10 % of total mission budget OR sufficient for: 1× contingency manoeuvre, 5× attitude desat, end-of-life deorbit/graveyard, whichever is greater.

title: Active cooling loop pressure
body: Active cooling loop pressure shall be 200–800 kPa nominal. Pressure drop > 50 kPa/hour or pressure < 150 kPa indicates leak; isolate suspected segment, switch to redundant loop within 30 min.
citation: ISS Active Thermal Control System Operations Handbook
